name: PT Xolare RCR Energy TBK
summary: PT Xolare RCR Energy TBK engages in asphalt trading in Indonesia. It operates through two segments, Asphalt and Construction. The company distributes penetration grade asphalt/bitumen under the XOLABIT brand name; and offers customized solutions for various types of emulsified asphalt, polymer modified asphalt, natural rubber modified asphalt, coldmix, waterproofing, and asphalt paint. It also offers engineering, procurement, and construction services for gas steam, biomass, and solar PV power plants; installation, testing, and commissioning services; construction services for switchyard and substations, industrial buildings, and pipelines; and mechanical and electrical construction services…
